steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX event creation for the test company.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Configure the event as a single-stage auction.
Select the first available auction template and render its pricing sheet.
Confirm that an auction template was applied.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Populate required pricing-sheet fields so the event can be completed.
Set the first line item's delivery location.
Verify the requested delivery location was retained.

args.goal: On the buyer's single-stage auction create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add two clauses, mark exactly one clause as Required, save the terms, and stop on the screen showing the configured clauses.

steps.note: Configure the two clauses with one required clause; no dedicated catalog step exposes this editor.
Invite one QA vendor to the auction.
Confirm the buyer reached a published project page.
Move to the invited QA vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the auction's vendor bid sheet.
Attempt to bid 100 without accepting the required clause and verify submission is blocked.
